heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
T-2 Days to EO Milestone — Luna: 'I Saw Nonhuman Origin Evidence in SCIF'
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. Two days remain until Trump's May 20 executive order 90-day milestone. DefenseScoop (May 14): six disclosure officials say PURSUE Tranche 1 is 'data release, not disclosure' — calling for contextual summaries, chain-of-custody documentation, and accountability. Rep. Luna told Newsweek she personally observed 'things of nonhuman origin and creation' inside a SCIF, contradicting AARO's official position. Tranche 2 — expected to include Luna's 46 whistleblower-identified videos — is anticipated around June 7. Time magazine analysis of Tranche 1 highlights a recurring nuclear-facility pattern across unresolved cases.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
